game_concept: A adventure race set in Sand Dunes – Camel Trail, a camel trail: the oasis keeper must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Pseudocode Bridge: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap.
theme: Sand Dunes – Camel Trail: a camel trail
core_gameplay_loop: In Camel Trail, repeat each round: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the oasis keeper ahead. Then check the bridge value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the caravan wagon by solving code steps involving bridge that move the oasis keeper forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the caravan wagon first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 3 (intro tier): Pseudocode Bridge
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pseudocode Bridge' (Week 9 slot 11), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Camel Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against scarab swarms in Camel Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
